assay: small RNA-seq of plasma extracellular-vesicle RNA (miRBase v22, featureCounts raw counts)
primary_estimand: Effect of one acute aerobic exercise bout (45 min cycling in TD, 45 min Frame Running in CP) on EV microRNA cargo: 30 min post vs pre within TD EX and within CP EX; secondary (associational) CP vs TD at baseline and post-exercise
sample_inclusion: Only TD EX (n=10) and CP EX (n=9) participants were sequenced; pre and post samples pooled to N=3 pools per timepoint per group (TD: 2 pools of 3 men, 1 pool of 4 women; CP: 3 pools by GMFCS II/III/IV) (S2.6.p1). TD CON participants (no-exercise controls) were NOT sequenced.
repeated_measure_unit: pool of participants; the same pools are sampled pre and post, but which GEO pool index corresponds across timepoints is not documented
planned_contrasts: TD post vs pre (S3.3.p1 'Exercise did not affect EV cargo in any of the groups', Supp Fig S2; paper: 0 DE miRNAs)
CP post vs pre (S3.3.p1, S4.p7; paper: 0 DE miRNAs)
CP vs TD at baseline (S3.3.p1, FIG2A/B: miR-486 up; let-7a, let-7b, let-7e down)
CP vs TD post-exercise (S3.3.p1, FIG2C/D: miR-486, miR-100 up; miR-877, miR-4433 down)
normalization: DESeq2 size factors; miRNAs with < 10 counts removed (S2.9.p2)
paper_method: DESeq2 in R 3.6.2, model with genotype (TD/CP) and activity (EX/CON = pre/post); no pool/pairing term stated (S2.9.p2)
paper_results: No exercise effect on EV miRNA cargo in any group (S3.3.p1, S4.p7)
